pyq_focus: NET mein Unit 10 se har paper mein 8-10 sawal aate hain, aur sabse zyada MLA Handbook se poochha jaata hai.
MLA 9th edition (2021) ke 9 core elements ka order ratna zaroori hai: Author, Title of source, Title of container, Other contributors, Version, Number, Publisher, Publication date, Location.
Works Cited entry mein punctuation, italics vs quotation marks, et al. ka use, aur 'Works Cited' heading jaise chhote details baar baar poochhe gaye hain.
In-text citation (author-page, jaise (Said 23)), hanging indent half inch, double spacing aur 1 inch margins yaad rakho.
Latin abbreviations (ibid., op. cit., loc. cit., et al., sic, viz., cf.) ke meaning par direct aur match-the-following sawal aate hain.
Plagiarism par UGC Regulations 2018 ke levels (0-10%, 10-40%, 40-60%, above 60%) aur unki penalties zaroor padho.
Research types (fundamental, applied, action, historical, descriptive), hypothesis, primary vs secondary sources aur research process ke steps ka order poochha jaata hai.
APA, Chicago, MHRA jaise dusre style manuals kis subject mein use hote hain, aur MLA ka kaunsa edition kab aaya, yeh chronology sawalon mein aata hai.
Preparation: MLA 9 ke sample entries khud likh kar practice karo, abbreviations ki list roz revise karo, aur pichhle 5 saal ke Unit 10 PYQ solve karo.

easy.title: What is Research: Types and Approaches
easy.story: Research matlab kisi sawal ka jawab dhang se, step by step dhoondhna. Jaise mummy ko pata karna ho ki doodh kyon phat gaya, to woh check karti hai: bartan, garmi, doodh ki date. Fundamental research sirf samajhne ke liye hoti hai, applied research kisi problem ko solve karne ke liye. Action research teacher apni hi class sudharne ke liye karta hai. Literary research mein hum texts, authors aur contexts ko dhyan se padhkar naya point nikaalte hain.
easy.trick: FAAD yaad rakho: Fundamental, Applied, Action, Descriptive. 'Research FAAD ke karo!'

easy.title: Steps of the Research Process
easy.story: Research ek recipe jaisi hai. Pehle decide karo kya banana hai (problem chunna), phir purani recipes dekho (review of literature). Phir guess karo ki kya result aayega (hypothesis), phir saaman jodo (data collection). Phir pakao aur chakho (analysis), aur aakhir mein sabko batao (report writing).
easy.trick: 'Pyaar Ro Har Din Aaj Raat': Problem, Review, Hypothesis, Data, Analysis, Report.

easy.title: Hypothesis
easy.story: Hypothesis ek samajhdaar andaza hai jise baad mein test kiya jaata hai. Jaise tum kaho, 'Shayad baarish ki wajah se Raju school nahi aaya,' aur phir pata karo ki sach hai ya nahi. Null hypothesis kehti hai ki koi farak ya rishta nahi hai. Alternative hypothesis kehti hai ki farak hai. Achhi hypothesis clear, testable aur chhoti honi chahiye.
easy.trick: Null = 'Nil', yaani kuch nahi; koi relation nahi. H0 ka zero yaad rakho.

easy.title: Primary, Secondary and Tertiary Sources
easy.story: Primary source asli cheez hai, jaise khud Hamlet ka text ya kisi lekhak ki diary. Secondary source woh hai jo us asli cheez ke baare mein likha gaya, jaise Hamlet par critic ka essay. Tertiary source sab ko jama karke batata hai, jaise encyclopedia ya bibliography. Jaise mela khud dekhna primary hai, dost se sunna secondary, aur akhbaar ki list tertiary.
easy.trick: 1-2-3: Asli, Asli ke baare mein, Sab ka summary (encyclopedia).

easy.title: Review of Literature
easy.story: Review of literature matlab tumhare topic par pehle kya kya likha ja chuka hai, uska jaayza lena. Jaise naya dukaan kholne se pehle dekhte ho ki gali mein kaunsi dukaanein pehle se hain. Isse research gap milta hai, yaani woh jagah jahan abhi kisi ne kaam nahi kiya. Review se repetition bhi bachta hai.
easy.trick: Review ka kaam: 'Gap dhoondo, gappe nahi.'

easy.title: MLA Handbook 9th Edition: Core Elements
easy.story: MLA 9th edition 2021 mein aaya. Ismein har source ko 9 core elements ki ek list se likhte hain, jaise tiffin ke 9 dabbe ek order mein. Author, Title of source, Title of container, Other contributors, Version, Number, Publisher, Publication date, Location. Container woh bada dabba hai jismein source rakha hai, jaise journal ya website.
easy.trick: 'A Teacher Takes Our Village Near Pune Daily Lunch': Author, Title, Title of container, Other contributors, Version, Number, Publisher, Date, Location.

easy.title: MLA 9: Works Cited Format and Examples
easy.story: Works Cited paper ke aakhir mein sources ki list hai, author ke surname ke alphabetical order mein. Har entry ki pehli line left mein, baaki lines aadha inch andar, isse hanging indent kehte hain. Kitab ka naam italics mein, aur essay ya poem ka naam quotation marks mein. Jaise class register mein naam surname se line mein lagte hain.
easy.trick: 'Bada naam tircha, chhota naam quotes mein': book italics, article quotes.

easy.title: MLA 9: In-text Citation and Manuscript Format
easy.story: Jab tum kisi ki baat apne paper mein likhte ho, to bracket mein uska naam aur page number dete ho, jaise (Eliot 47). Comma nahi lagta, aur 'p.' bhi nahi. Paper double spaced, 1 inch margin, aur readable font jaise Times New Roman 12 mein hota hai. Yeh sab thank you note jaisa hai, jo batata hai ki baat kiski hai.
easy.trick: (Naam Page), na comma na p: 'Naam page, bas itna hi kaafi!'

easy.title: APA, Chicago and Other Style Manuals
easy.story: Har subject ka apna citation ka tareeka hai, jaise har school ki apni uniform. MLA literature aur humanities ke liye, APA psychology aur social sciences ke liye, Chicago history aur publishing ke liye. APA mein saal bracket mein author ke baad aata hai, jaise (Smith, 2020). MHRA British humanities mein chalta hai.
easy.trick: 'MLA Mein Literature, APA Mein Psychology, Chicago Mein History'.

easy.title: Latin Abbreviations and Notes
easy.story: Purane scholar Latin ke chhote shabd use karte the taaki baar baar poora naam na likhna pade. Ibid. matlab wahi source jo abhi upar diya. Op. cit. matlab pehle diya gaya kaam. Et al. matlab aur log, sic matlab galti original mein hi hai. Jaise ghar mein 'wahi wala' bolkar kaam chala lete hain.
easy.trick: 'Ibid = Isi Book mein Dobara'; 'Sic = Sach mein aisa hi likha tha'.

easy.title: Plagiarism and UGC Regulations
easy.story: Plagiarism matlab kisi aur ka likha apna bata dena, jaise dost ka homework copy karke apne naam se dena. UGC ne 2018 mein regulations banaye. 10% tak similarity chalti hai, 10-40% par Level 1, 40-60% par Level 2, 60% se upar Level 3 penalty. Isse bachne ke liye har idea ka source batao.
easy.trick: '10 tak theek, 40 par chetavni, 60 par saza, upar to bada saza.'

easy.title: Research and Publication Ethics
easy.story: Ethics matlab research mein imaandaari. Data banana (fabrication), data badalna (falsification) aur copy karna (plagiarism) teen bade paap hain, inhe FFP kehte hain. Predatory journals paise lekar kuch bhi chhaap dete hain, unse bacho. COPE jaisi bodies publication ethics ke rules batati hain.
easy.trick: FFP: 'Fake, Fiddle, Pinch' = Fabrication, Falsification, Plagiarism.

easy.title: Bibliography and Textual Criticism
easy.story: Bibliography sirf kitabon ki list nahi, kitab ko ek cheez ki tarah padhna bhi hai: kagaz, chhapai, editions. Textual criticism ka kaam hai lekhak ka asli text dhoondhna jab alag copies mein farak ho. Jaise Shakespeare ke Quarto aur Folio mein alag shabd milte hain. Greg ne 'copy-text' ka idea diya.
easy.trick: Greg ka 'copy-text' = 'sabse bharosemand copy ko base banao'.

easy.title: Annotation, Abstract and Note-taking
easy.story: Annotation matlab kitab ke margin mein chhote notes likhna. Abstract research paper ka chhota summary hai, aam taur par 150-300 words, jo paper se pehle aata hai. Note-taking mein hum card ya app par quotes aur page number likhte hain. Jaise exam se pehle chhoti chit mein important points.
easy.trick: Abstract = 'Aage ka trailer', poori film nahi.

easy.title: Structure of Thesis and Research Paper
easy.story: Thesis ek ghar ki tarah banta hai. Pehle title page, declaration, certificate, acknowledgement, phir abstract aur contents. Phir Introduction, chapters, aur Conclusion. Aakhir mein Works Cited ya Bibliography aur appendices. Har hissa apni jagah par hona chahiye.
easy.trick: IMRaD science paper ke liye: Introduction, Methods, Results and Discussion.

easy.title: Archives and Archival Research
easy.story: Archive woh jagah hai jahan purane documents, letters, manuscripts sambhal kar rakhe jaate hain. Jaise dadi ka purana sandook jismein purani chitthiyan hoti hain. Archival research mein hum in asli papers ko padhkar itihaas ya lekhak ki zindagi samajhte hain. India mein National Archives of India New Delhi mein hai.
easy.trick: Archive = 'Dadi ka sandook', jahan sab asli aur purana.

easy.title: Digital Humanities and Research Tools
easy.story: Digital Humanities matlab computer se literature padhna. Hazaaron novels ek saath computer se scan karke patterns dhoondhna, jaise Franco Moretti ka 'distant reading'. Zotero, Mendeley jaise tools references sambhalte hain. JSTOR, Project Gutenberg, Shodhganga jaise sites se papers aur books milti hain.
easy.trick: Shodhganga = Indian theses ki Ganga; Moretti = 'door se padho'.

easy.title: Qualitative and Quantitative Methods
easy.story: Quantitative research numbers mein baat karti hai, jaise kitne students ne kitne marks liye. Qualitative research shabdon aur arth mein baat karti hai, jaise students kaisa mehsoos karte hain. Interview, case study qualitative hain, survey aur statistics quantitative. Dono milao to mixed method bante hain.

quotes.quote: Research is a systematized effort to gain new knowledge.
quotes.by: L. L. Redman and A. V. H. Mory

quotes.quote: Research comprises defining and redefining problems, formulating hypothesis or suggested solutions; collecting, organising and evaluating data; making deductions and reaching conclusions; and at last carefully testing the conclusions to determine whether they fit the formulating hypothesis.
quotes.source: quoted in C. R. Kothari, Research Methodology

quotes.quote: Scientific research is systematic, controlled, empirical, and critical investigation of hypothetical propositions about the presumed relations among natural phenomena.
A hypothesis is a conjectural statement of the relation between two or more variables.
A hypothesis is a proposition which can be put to a test to determine its validity.
quotes.by: William J. Goode and Paul K. Hatt

quotes.quote: A hypothesis is a tentative generalization, the validity of which remains to be tested.
Social research is a systematic method of discovering new facts or verifying old facts, their sequence, interrelationships, causal explanations and the natural laws which govern them.
Research is a careful investigation or inquiry specially through search for new facts in any branch of knowledge.
quotes.by: Advanced Learner's Dictionary of Current English

quotes.quote: Research is simply gathering the information you need to answer a question and thereby help you solve a problem.
quotes.by: Wayne C. Booth, Gregory G. Colomb and Joseph M. Williams

quotes.quote: Research is formalized curiosity. It is poking and prying with a purpose.
Active, persistent, and careful consideration of any belief or supposed form of knowledge in the light of the grounds that support it, and the further conclusions to which it tends.
quotes.source: How We Think, 1910 (definition of reflective thought)

quotes.quote: The criterion of the scientific status of a theory is its falsifiability, or refutability, or testability.
Paradigms are universally recognized scientific achievements that for a time provide model problems and solutions to a community of practitioners.
If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of Giants.
quotes.source: letter to Robert Hooke, 1675 (often used for review of literature)

quotes.quote: Knowledge is of two kinds. We know a subject ourselves, or we know where we can find information upon it.
quotes.source: in James Boswell, The Life of Samuel Johnson, 1791

quotes.quote: Lexicographer: a writer of dictionaries; a harmless drudge.
quotes.source: A Dictionary of the English Language, 1755

quotes.quote: Qualitative research is an approach for exploring and understanding the meaning individuals or groups ascribe to a social or human problem.
Quantitative research is an approach for testing objective theories by examining the relationship among variables.
Man is an animal suspended in webs of significance he himself has spun.
Plagiarism means the practice of taking someone else's work or idea and passing them as one's own.
Plagiarism is presenting another person's ideas, information, expressions, or entire work as one's own.
Research misconduct is defined as fabrication, falsification, or plagiarism in proposing, performing, or reviewing research, or in reporting research results.
quotes.by: US Office of Science and Technology Policy

quotes.quote: The voluntary consent of the human subject is absolutely essential.
Three basic ethical principles: respect for persons, beneficence and justice.
quotes.by: US National Commission for the Protection of Human Subjects

quotes.quote: Immature poets imitate; mature poets steal.
quotes.source: essay on Philip Massinger, The Sacred Wood, 1920

quotes.quote: Textual criticism is a science, and, since it comprises recension and emendation, it is also an art. It is the science of discovering error in texts and the art of removing it.
quotes.source: The Application of Thought to Textual Criticism, 1921

quotes.quote: The copy-text should govern (generally) in the matter of accidentals, but the choice between substantive readings belongs to the general theory of textual criticism.
Bibliography is the discipline that studies texts as recorded forms, and the processes of their transmission, including their production and reception.
quotes.source: Bibliography and the Sociology of Texts, 1986

quotes.quote: Distance, let me repeat it, is a condition of knowledge: it allows you to focus on units that are much smaller or much larger than the text.
The archive is first the law of what can be said.
There is no political power without control of the archive, if not of memory.
Omit needless words.
Never use a long word where a short one will do.
Books are for use.
quotes.source: The Five Laws of Library Science, 1931 (first law)

quotes.quote: Ibid. (ibidem) means 'in the same place': the same source as the note immediately before.
Op. cit. (opere citato) means 'in the work cited' earlier; loc. cit. (loco citato) means 'in the place cited'.
Et al. (et alii) means 'and others'; MLA 9 uses it for a source with three or more authors.
Sic means 'thus': the error is in the original quotation.
Cf. (confer) means 'compare'; viz. (videlicet) means 'namely'; passim means 'here and there throughout'.
A container is the larger whole that holds a source, such as a journal holding an article or a website holding a page.
Distant reading: understanding literature not by studying particular texts but by aggregating and analysing massive amounts of data.
quotes.source: concept from Conjectures on World Literature, 2000
